title: Dating: 2020 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember dressing up for dates only from the waist up?
In person now, and the pajama pants still made the cut.

title: Aquarius dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever explained a whole galaxy theory on a first date?
Aquarius still has the theories, but now asks for yours too. Weird, together.

title: Aries dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Aries in 2016 said I love you on date one. In a food court.
Aries in 2026 asks first. Same fire, better timing.

title: Cancer dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Cancer made a full scrapbook after one week of dating.
Ten years later, the album is digital and the feelings are still soft.

title: Capricorn dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever got an "out of office" reply to a dinner invite?
Capricorn still signs off "best regards," but now answers at 11 PM. Office closed, heart open.

title: Checking compatibility: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember answering a love quiz for both of you?
Libra and Aquarius now read their match together and talk through the hard parts.

title: Telling friends about a crush: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Did you ever make a whole slideshow about your crush?
Leo still does, but this time the crush is at the table. Some things never change.

title: The first date: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Remember first dates hiding behind giant menus?
A walk and one good question beats one pea on a fancy plate. Less fancy, more real.

title: Gemini dating: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Gemini in 2016: forty texts in a row.
Gemini in 2026: one voice note, nine minutes long. Growth, technically.

title: Getting over someone: 2016 vs 2026
old_caption:
Ever played the same sad song on repeat for closure?
Cancer trades the dark room for a walk, a friend and a lumpy pot. Feel it, then go outside.
